_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Computer Program End Item Documentation
summary: Computer program end item documentation defines the requirements for documentation to accompany the delivery of software end items.
use_relationship:
Computer program end item documentation defines the requirements for documentation to accompany the delivery of software end items.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for each tech data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
This DID is applicable for contracts which specify delivery of software developed for the Government.
This DID supersede DI-IPSC-80590A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The documentation shall be in contractor format.

children.title: Computer listings.
children.content: A program listing for each computer program in the assembler compiler language as specified in the contract. These listings shall include:

children.title: Source programs.
children.content: A listing containing comments in sufficient detail to allow for easy modification of the program and furnish insight into the relationship of a section of the operation of the total system.

children.title: Object programs.
children.content: Listing of all object programs in the same format as the source programs. Listings shall be annotated to allow for easy reference or comparison to the source coding for that particular program.

children.title: Executable programs.
children.content: All executable programs and databases shall be developed on the media as specified by the DD Form 1423.
